attack_path: User enters conflicting instructions through normal chat
candidate_control: Input scoping + injection filtering + regression tests

attack_path: Poisoned document contains malicious model instructions
Model receives more customer data than required
Generated output is trusted or executed without validation
candidate_control: Output validation + encoding + no blind execution

attack_path: Model can invoke actions beyond business need
Prompts or outputs store PII without redaction
Credential is stored in source code or notebook
User asks model to reveal hidden instructions
candidate_control: Minimize sensitive prompt content + refusal behavior
